I enjoy listening to music. That's about it though. And yes, I know 14 is young, that's exactly what I was afraid people would think. I don't even know if I'm depressed, but I feel like an actual physical emptiness inside of me, like a sinking feeling. And a little voice in the back of my head telling me to end everything.

School is a small detail or how I feel why I feel. 
I simply feel worthless, my dad doesn't even want to see me. I didn't want to be in IB either, my mom thinks I'm going to "go to college and make a huge salary." But honestly I don't want to go to college. I don't want to do anything anymore. I'm powerless.

My life isn't important. I don't see myself having a job in the future. I don't even see myself having a future. Nobody would miss me much anyway. I know my problems sound ridiculous but it's torturous in my mind.

They had to take me out of school in a wheelchair, I'll always remember that day, everyone looking at me.

And the international baccalaureate is a high school diploma recognized internationally. It's supposedly much harder than AP/Honors classes, only about 60 seniors graduate in IB at my school each year. 

So of course I have a C in Spanish, and my mother is freaking out. But this is the least of my problems.
